pageRenderFailed: The selected page could not be rendered. Your draft is retained.
previewPrivacy: Preview blocked: selected content contains a local path or credential pattern.
previewFailed: Preview could not load. Refresh to retry.
deleteConfirm: Delete {name} from every page using it? You can undo this before saving.
copy: Make a separate copy for this page
name: Design name
shared: Edits to this design update every page using it.
defaultHelp: Applies to pages using the site default, including new pages. Explicit page choices are retained.
pagesHelp: Checked pages use this design. Changes stay in your website draft until you save the website.
assignmentLimit: The website has reached its limit of 5,000 page design assignments. Use a site default to apply a design to all pages.
contentsHelp: Links are generated from this page's visible section headings. They follow the page when reused elsewhere.
footerHelp: Use the same elements as the page. Powered by Observanda follows your footer text's alignment and colors. It is centered only when there is no authored footer.
missing: Choose or create a design to add elements here.
invalid: Complete the highlighted design setting before saving.
elementLimit: This design has reached its element limit.
limit: You can save up to 100 shared region designs.
scope: Workspace canvas includes unpublished content. Use Public content to choose what appears in Preview & export.
historyLimited: Earlier undo steps were released to limit memory use. Your current changes are kept.
titleHelp: Leave blank to hide the website title. Page titles still identify browser tabs and links.
navigationHelp: Choose the links visitors see. Menu choices do not publish content; excluded destinations appear only in the private editor.
menuKeyboard: To reorder, press Space on a move handle, use arrow keys, then Space to place or Escape to cancel.
menuUnpublished: Excluded from export. You can still design its menu link.
disclosureHelp: Add or drag elements inside this section. Its contents stay visible while designing; visitors can expand or collapse them.
headerHelp: An assigned design replaces the automatic website title and menu on this page. Arrange images, text, links and other elements here; reuse the design on selected pages or throughout the site.
popupHelp: Add text, links, images and copyable text inside this popup. Its content stays open while designing. Visitors open it with the button; without scripts it expands on the page.
copyHelp: Enter the exact public text visitors should copy, such as a wallet address, and identify its network in the heading or description. The text also stays visible for manual selection.
action_siteHelp: Text links and buttons have separate defaults. Individual elements can override them in Style. Navigation links and prose keep their own typography.
action_inheritHelp: Empty values follow the website defaults. Overrides apply only to this control.
action_siteInheritHelp: Empty values follow the website theme. Individual controls can override these defaults.
